test_title: PYST 32: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: In a test consisting of 80 questions, Anita answered 60% of the first 55 questions correctly. What per cent of the remaining questions should she answer correctly to obtain 70% in the entire exam?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total question to be answered correctly = 70over100 × 80 = 56

Questions already answered correctly = 60over100 × 55 = 33

Remaining number of questions to be answered correctly = 56 - 33 = 23

Remaining questions available = 80 - 55 = 25

Required percentage = 23over 25 × 100 = 92%

∴ **Anita should answer 92% of the remaining questions correctly.**
